جعفر بن علي بن الحسن الكوفي

notes: two routes to the same book of al-Hasan b. Ali al-Kufi, both written by the compiler; not two sayings
«أبي» and «أبيه» are bare relations with no name written (rule 7)
«جدّه الحسن بن علي الكوفي» is one link, the grandfather's name alone (occurrence 3 of that string)
